title: Your Parallaxa
intro: Choose where and what you care about. We narrow by place and topic only, never by side: every story still shows every side.

places.title: Places
places.help: Up to 5. One is your home (used for the perception quiz and local context).
places.max: You can choose up to 5 places.

topics.title: Topics
topics.help: Followed topics come first. Muted topics are left out of the briefing and alerts, never out of Check.

briefing.title: Daily briefing
briefing.outsideHelp: A major event outside your places or topics, so personalization doesn't become a bubble.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: At most one routine notification a day, plus updates you asked for (up to 3).
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. On iPhone, add Parallaxa to your home screen first.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.help: Without an account, everything here stays on this device.
